_comment: The five topics. A walker picks three. Five choose three is ten, so the ten routes map one-to-one onto the possible picks. Ids are stable and are used to build combo keys, so never rename one.

topics.name: Roman London
topics.blurb: Londinium is still here. Most of it is below you, some of it is at eye level.

topics.name: The Great Fire
topics.blurb: Four days in 1666, and the fifty years of building that followed.
topics.blurb_spoken: Four days in sixteen sixty-six, and the fifty years of building that followed.

topics.name: Lost Rivers
topics.blurb: The water is still running. It is just under the road.

topics.name: Small Marks
topics.blurb: Boundary stones, ghost signs and iron. Nothing here is famous.

topics.name: Fleet Street
topics.blurb: Five hundred years of printing on one street, and none of it left.
